posts.en:
dsh-git-identity is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Pin Git commits to the environment's own author identity; env-var injection overrides all `git config` settings.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-74775b734e6b7e7e732c.html
